description: This file contains implementation of message bus interface functions for the XxxxSsp component, including message handling, bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource freeing, and bus checking. It interacts with the CCSP message bus and defines callback functions for message processing and resource management.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface, returns 0 on success.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message bus interface, calls ssp_cancel, returns 0 on success.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the bus status, currently always returns 0.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources based on priority, calls ssp_cancel for high priority.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Connects to the message bus, registers callbacks, and sets up message handling.
